content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RDPR Madurai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.madurai.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RDPR Madurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RDPR Madurai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is 10th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For Office Assistant, 8th pass with bicycle riding ability is required. For Record Clerk, 10th pass is needed. For Driver, 8th pass with a valid driving license and 5 years of experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 18 years and 42 years as of 1st July 2026. Age relaxation is provided for SC and Ex-Servicemen categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Madurai.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 15700 to Rs. 71900 per month, depending on the post and its corresponding pay level. Specific details are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for various posts in the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Madurai.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves Document Verification and an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department, Madurai. Direct links are usually provided in the 'Important Links' section of recruitment articles.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Tamil Nadu apply?
faq.answer: The notification is released by the Madurai district unit of the Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department. While not explicitly stated, it is generally advisable for candidates to check the domicile requirements mentioned in the official notification to confirm eligibility.
